entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-06-29
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Clean up `CompositeMLDsaAlgorithm` and add tests #117134
    10.0.0
  • [API Proposal]: Make JsonReaderHelper public #117131
  • `/azp run runtime-nativeaot-outerloop` fails with "error : Helix API does not contain an entry for AzureLinux.3.ArmArch.open" #117126
  • ILLink.RoslynAnalyzer asserts on tuple swap involving implicit indexer reference #117122

Closed

  • BackgroundService with ExecuteAsync Task appears to eat exception #117014
  • [API Proposal]: Add a constructor for AesCng to accept a CngKey reference #116842
    10.0.0
  • `AddRange` in `BlockingCollection` #117129
  • Named mutex not working on Linux and MacOS when AOT compiling #110348
    Future
  • Length calculation in objwriter looks suspicious #78409
    Future
  • What is needed to add support for a new Native AOT platform? #103065
    Future

  • Clean up CompositeMLDsaAlgorithm and add comprehensive tests #117135
